mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% over 3 months are followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between RSAFS growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month are followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE spikes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO declines and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the market anticipates aggressive rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified trigger condition is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL on 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month are followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances, or if the correlation between PAYEMS growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained 3-month decline in HOUST is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST declines and 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, the market anticipates a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the specified trigger condition is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of low GDP growth and high FEDFUNDS on 60-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
